about: Payment network simulator for live demos. These fictional banks stand in for the real payment network. Each bank has its own hidden rules. DejaVu never reads this file: like an ops analyst, it only sees the status messages the banks send back.

rules.summary: Moved to 14-digit account numbers on 1 Oct 2026. Old 11-digit numbers are rejected.

outcome.message: Beneficiary account {account} not found. Please verify and resend.

rules.analyst_note: Called Charminar Co-operative Bank's Hyderabad operations desk: they moved to 14-digit account numbers on 1 Oct 2026. Old 11-digit numbers must be prefixed with branch code 500. Repaired the account number and resent - accepted.

rules.summary: Moved to 15-digit account numbers on 25 Aug 2026. Old 12-digit numbers need the branch prefix 601.

outcome.message: Beneficiary account {account} not found. Please verify and resend.

rules.analyst_note: Pearl Delta Commercial Bank migrated to 15-digit account numbers on 25 Aug 2026. Prefixed the old 12-digit number with branch code 601 and resent - accepted.

rules.summary: Trade payments above USD 10,000 must carry an invoice number in the remittance information.

outcome.message: Payment rejected. Reason: RR04 Regulatory reason.

rules.analyst_note: Called Victoria Harbour Bank: their compliance rules require an invoice number in the remittance information for trade payments above USD 10,000. Got the invoice number from the client and resubmitted - accepted.

rules.summary: USD payments must go via Hudson Federal Bank since 1 Sep 2026. The old route via Atlantic Clearing Bank is rejected.

outcome.message: Bank identifier incorrect. Payment rejected by intermediary.

rules.analyst_note: Nordkyst Bank moved its USD correspondent from Atlantic Clearing Bank New York to Hudson Federal Bank New York on 1 Sep 2026. Updated the settlement instructions and resent via Hudson Federal - accepted.

rules.summary: Exact beneficiary name matching: abbreviated suffixes like 'Pvt Ltd' are rejected; the full legal name ('Private Limited') is required.

outcome.message: Beneficiary name does not match the account holder name. Payment rejected.

rules.analyst_note: Tungabhadra Co-operative Bank does exact name matching. Amended the beneficiary name to the full legal suffix 'Private Limited' and resent - accepted.

rules.summary: Same-day cut-off is 12:00 IST (14:30 SGT). Later payments are credited on the next business day.

outcome.message: Received after Golconda Commercial Bank's same-day cut-off (14:30 SGT). It will be credited on the next business day.

rules.summary: Beneficiary names similar to the listed entity 'Desert Star Shipping FZE' are held for sanctions screening.

outcome.message: Payment held by sanctions screening: beneficiary name matched watch-list entry 'Desert Star Shipping FZE' (score 0.86). Pending review.

rules.analyst_note: Compliance confirmed this beneficiary is the previously cleared Desert Star General Trading LLC, not the listed Desert Star Shipping FZE. Released with the clearance reference attached.
